about: The Workbench icons of the Alex4 drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/alex4.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a little green allegator on a brick ledge, a cherry and a star) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/alex4.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Alex4-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Alex4.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Alex4.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, LICENSE.txt, README-Alex4.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the Data and User drawers' icon.
